findings.finding: Trusted provisioning could null and relink a stable profile, inheriting existing grants despite recovery being deferred.
findings.resolution: Database-owned immutable auth_linked_once history; initial suspended-profile attachment only. Manual unlink and Auth deletion preserve history and cannot reopen linking eligibility.
findings.focused_verification: service_role replacement rejected with SQLSTATE 23514; history remained true; replacement subject saw zero accounts.
